summary: Exact-head CI on adversarial PR #325 confirms the unresolved caller-supplied PolicyConfig no-execute boundary on current main. Format, lint, Luau analysis, canonical-randomness, domain-boundary, plain-value and Swarm deterministic checks all passed; Pure Luau then failed only the six new PolicyConfig assertions. FidelityManager.new accepted a metatable-backed config and executed __index 13 times; evaluatePolicy accepted a metatable-backed config and executed __index 34 times; an otherwise-valid inert-metatable config was accepted; and a hostile numeric config scalar executed one comparison metamethod before rejection. This upgrades the prior static finding to executable source-level proof. Primary #274 should either harden PolicyConfig as plain/no-execute data with equivalent regressions or explicitly document the configuration boundary as trusted code-owned input and supersede these tests.
evidence: All CI steps through Swarm control-plane deterministic tests passed; Pure Luau was the first product-suite failure.
FAIL constructor rejects metatable-backed PolicyConfig: expected false, got true; constructor __index reads expected 0, got 13.
FAIL pure policy rejects metatable-backed PolicyConfig: expected false, got true; pure-policy __index reads expected 0, got 34.
FAIL pure policy rejects inert PolicyConfig metatable: expected false, got true.
Hostile PolicyConfig numeric scalar was rejected, but zero-execute assertion failed: expected 0 metamethod executions, got 1.
